grammarFocus: 名词性从句入门；that 从句；情态动词与条件表达。
title: The Smart Locker and the Missing Note
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是真实事件，也不是官方考试。请根据文章内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。
passage:
A

Last month, a new smart locker system arrived at Greenfield Community Centre. The centre is a busy place. It has a small gym, a reading room, and a swimming pool. Many members come every day. They leave their bags and clothes in the lockers near the front door. The new system uses a small camera and a fingerprint scanner. Members can open their lockers with a code or with their finger. The centre manager, Mr. Chen, said that the system would make the centre safer. "We want members to feel that their things are protected," he explained. He also told the members that the old keys were often lost. He believes that the new system will save time and money.

B

However, not everyone was happy. On the first day, a member named Lily could not open her locker. She typed her code three times, but the locker stayed shut. A staff member helped her, but Lily felt embarrassed. Later, she found a note inside her locker. The note said, "Your code is not safe. Change it." Lily was worried. She did not know who wrote the note. She asked two friends, but they did not know either. That evening, she called the centre and spoke to Mr. Chen. She told him that she felt unhappy about the note. She also said that she wanted to know who could open her locker.

C

Mr. Chen called a meeting on Friday. He told the members that the centre would check the camera recordings. "We need to find out what happened," he said. Some members asked if the camera was always on. Mr. Chen explained that the camera only recorded when someone used the fingerprint scanner. He also said that the centre would not keep the recordings for more than seven days. One member, Mrs. Park, asked a good question. She asked whether the centre would tell members before it checked the recordings. Mr. Chen promised that the centre would always send an email first. He added that members could ask to see their own records at any time.

D

A week later, the centre discovered the truth. A young staff member, Ben, had written the note. He wanted to test if the system was secure. He did not think about how Lily would feel. Mr. Chen apologized to Lily and said that Ben would receive training. Ben also said sorry to Lily in person. He explained that he had used a master code to open the locker. He promised that he would not do it again. The centre also decided to put a clear sign on each locker: "This locker is monitored. Your privacy is important." The sign is small but easy to read.

E

Now, Lily uses the smart locker again. She says that she understands why the centre installed the system. "I think it is a good idea, but they must explain things better," she said. Mr. Chen agrees. He believes that new technology should come with clear information. If the centre buys more smart lockers next year, it will ask members for their opinions first. The centre is planning a short guide for all members. The guide will explain how the lockers work and how the centre protects private information. Mr. Chen hopes that members will read it and feel more confident.

grammar.title: 名词性从句入门：that 从句与情态动词条件表达
grammar.explanation: 英语中，that 从句可以放在动词后面，用来说明想法、说法或发现的内容。例如：He said that the system would make the centre safer. 这里的 that 从句作 said 的宾语。情态动词如 would, could, must 常用来表达意愿、能力或必要性。条件表达常用 if 引导，例如：if the system was secure。注意：that 在从句中不充当成分，口语中常省略。
grammar.example: Mr. Chen said that the system would make the centre safer.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a that-clause.
options: She thinks that the locker is safe.
She thinks the locker is safe that.
She thinks that is the locker safe.
She thinks locker that is safe.
answers: She thinks that the locker is safe.
questions.explanation: that 从句应放在动词 think 后面，且 that 后接完整句子。只有第一项正确。
questions.evidence: She thinks that the locker is safe.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: He said ___ he would come to the meeting.
questions.explanation: said 后面接 that 从句表示说的内容，因此用 that。
questions.evidence: He said that he would come to the meeting.

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses a modal verb for possibility?
questions.explanation: could 是情态动词，表示可能性。其他选项没有情态动词。

options: If you change your code, the locker will be safer.
If you change your code, the locker is safer.
If you will change your code, the locker is safer.
If you change your code, the locker safer.
answers: If you change your code, the locker will be safer.
questions.explanation: 条件句通常主句用 will，if 从句用一般现在时。第一项正确。
questions.evidence: If you change your code, the locker will be safer.
